caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The chair has four straight legs, with the front legs being vertical and the back legs slightly splayed. The seat is cushioned and covered with a light yellow-beige fabric featuring a subtle floral pattern in muted pink and red tones. The backrest consists of three curved horizontal wooden slats, each connected in the middle by a carved loop, and is flanked by two upward-curving side posts. The wooden frame of the chair is brown, and the drawing employs a realistic style with fine lines and careful shading to depict the structure and texture of the wood and upholstery.
title: Chippendale Chair
